acceptance_rule: Correctness, originality, and value must all pass.

correctness.rationale: The full source paper confirms a single realization satisfying all sufficiently large dyadic good events, because their failure probabilities are summable. Annular occupancy has mean at least \(\alpha m\); Chernoff plus Borel--Cantelli makes the lower occupancy simultaneous for all admissible annuli. Charging deleted annular points to source-controlled bad quadruples leaves a fixed linear fraction.
residual_risks: Constants depend on the source's universal estimate.

evidence: The source gives independent probabilities and all-large-scale deletion bounds simultaneously; only standard occupancy concentration is added.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The source gives independent probabilities and all-large-scale deletion bounds simultaneously; only standard occupancy concentration is added.

evidence: Pages 3--4 of the source sum failure probabilities over all dyadic scales; annular lower tails are likewise summable over all admissible pairs, so the audited theorem is a direct corollary.

originality.rationale: The annular wording is not printed as the source headline, but it is mechanically implied by the source's published summable dyadic good-event estimates plus standard Chernoff--Borel--Cantelli concentration for the same sampling law.
residual_risks: No access risk remains for the decisive source.

source_inspections.material_read: full 11-page preprint, especially Lemmas 2.1--2.2 and proof of Theorem 1.1

value.rationale: Uniform mesoscopic radial density is a natural strengthening of prefix density, but the scientific rejection is originality because it follows too directly from the published estimates.
residual_risks: No translated-window or arbitrarily thin-annulus statement follows.

final_claim: For each fixed \(\eta>0\), the Ghosal--Goenka weighted construction can be chosen with linear mass in every sufficiently large origin-centered square annulus of relative thickness at least \(\eta\), while avoiding four collinear or concyclic points.
limitations: Origin-centered square annuli only; fixed relative thickness; constants may depend on \(\eta\).
